en: {fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...You sure are a happy-go-lucky one. What about me is there to worry about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Relax. I ain't weak enough to need you worryin' over me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah. Walkin' around soakin' up the sun feels the best.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sittin' still at home just ain't my style.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...That's creepy. Why the heck would I think that?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Now that you mention it, maybe I am. Guess I'll grab some grub a little further on.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, it has. You been doin' okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You look busy runnin' all over the place, but you're pretty laid-back, huh.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sure, you always pop up outta nowhere, so it can surprise me. But that's how angels show up, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hm? How I'm doin'? Just like you see. Same as always.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Don't fuss so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I appreciate it, but... when you say it all formal like that, it kinda tickles.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...Me, lost? Ahahahahaha! How'd you come up with that?! You say the weirdest things.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How do you feel about becoming a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Well, I'm honored. It's the perfect chance for me to get stronger.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You don't get a shot at this much real combat every day. So in that sense, I'm grateful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Being a martial artist must be hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Sure. But 'cause it's hard, fightin' a real tough opponent feels like nothin' else.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The tension, the sense of achievement... There's more joy and fun in fighting than you think.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got somethin' else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...Me, lost? Ahahahahaha! How'd you come up with that?! You say the weirdest things.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}You're a guy and you say romantic stuff like that... That's creepy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nah, you ain't botherin' me. But, well, some folks might think so.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh, you're a real worrywart. But you don't gotta worry that much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And if you're gonna come, come at a decent hour.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Stayin' up late... I ain't great at it, but I don't hate it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Lettin' loose and partyin' all night is fine once in a while, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah. Well, leave it to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever get lonely?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm... Sure, there are times like that, but... I bounce right back.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, me sayin' I'm lonely just don't suit me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you fall asleep easily?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Truth is... I heard that with enough focus, you can control sleep however you want...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So if I can't fall asleep right away, guess my training's still lackin'. ...Hey, mind your own business.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}How can you say somethin' that embarrassing with a straight face...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}No way, nothin' like that. Even I wanna have fun sometimes.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Nope. Not at all. If you want, let's go wander around together.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I ain't tired. It's just to clear my head.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah? But I figure anyone looks that way when they're havin' fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You've got your body's condition too, right? In a fight, you push it to its peak.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That's how you beat strong guys. At the dojo they teach that havin' fun to get in shape is part of it too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you do for fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What do I do...? Just wander around. A walk, basically. A walk.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is that training?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Huh?! Training?! Hahaha!! No, no!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Today's just a walk. Somethin' like this is fine once in a while, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}There's more, right? Go ahead and say it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}That's just what a martial artist does. If you slack on trainin', you're in trouble when it counts.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Practice is my daily routine. Besides, if I half-ass it, I can't sleep right.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sure, it might be hard, but if you're aimin' to be the strongest, this much is nothin'. Better every day, y'know.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, I'm gonna keep at it a bit more. I've still got plenty left on today's list.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I run through all the basic forms, then a bunch of drills. Kicks, punches, combos, that kinda thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Training's all about stackin' up the basics. Even new moves only come from that kinda steady work.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Nah, not yet. If I stopped to rest every time, it wouldn't be training.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you train every day?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah. Course I do, every day. Skip even one day and your fightin' instincts get dull fast.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope your training pays off.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah! I'm hopin' it'll make me even a little stronger! Thanks. I'll do my best!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}No! Not at all. I'm so happy to be able to talk with you like this, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Oh, I-I'm fine. I'm sorry... I keep making you worry, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. I like it. I get to see forests and rivers and the sea... and meet all kinds of animals.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes. When I'm tired, I take a rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Fine, thanks to you. I'm doing my best. Please keep looking after me, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Oh, r-right, of course... I'll try harder...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It is. The breeze feels so nice too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Huh? Oh, um... My head's been so full of what's ahead. I hadn't thought about it. I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No, I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes, it has. I'm glad to see you looking well, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes. So very much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I never knew the view from a hilltop could be so beautiful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Oh, yes. I was surprised. I never thought I'd meet you in a place like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Oh... So I am making you worry after all, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Thank you. But I'm all right...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Um, I know I must seem unreliable, but I'll try harder and harder...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Oh, thank you. Today I'm still... all right.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you all right on ships and such?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Ships...? I haven't ridden on them much yet, so I'm not used to them.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}B-but I'll be fine. I'll do my best.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you worried about home?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Yes. I do think about it, so I'd like to go back whenever I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, they are.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Food tastes better with two than alone, and even better with lots of people than with two.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not at all. Besides, I happen to be free right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No, I'm not picky. Just being able to eat is something to be thankful for.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I do. Grandmother and Grandfather taught me all sorts of things.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Of course. With such a nice smell around, even an angel would get hungry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you eating your fill?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You ask such funny things, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But did you know, Angel? Eating until you're stuffed isn't actually good for you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you found any good places to eat?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I have. A bakery I went to the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Their fluffy bread was so delicious.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there anything else, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
